course.title: Touch Typing
course.tagline: Type fast without looking at the keys, and double your speed in 30 days.

days.title: Meet the keyboard
days.goal: Know the home row and where your fingers go.
steps: Watch today's video and set up your posture and home-row position for the home row: A S D F and J K L ;.
Do a 10-minute drill on typing.com or keybr.com focused on the home row: A S D F and J K L ;.
Type five lines of real text using the home row: A S D F and J K L ; without looking at the keyboard.
Take a 1-minute typing test and write down your WPM and accuracy.
Repeat your weakest drill from today once more before you stop.

days.challenge: Keep your fingers on the home row for five minutes without looking.

quiz.q: What is the home row?
options: The middle row of letters: A S D F and J K L ;.
The top row of numbers.
The bottom row of the keyboard.
The space bar.
quiz.explain: The home row is the middle row: A S D F under your left hand, J K L ; under your right hand.

quiz.q: Which of these is the goal of today's lesson?
options: Test your speed and accuracy.
Know the home row and where your fingers go.
Type a full paragraph without looking at the keys.
Type numbers and dates fast.
quiz.explain: Today's lesson is about Meet the keyboard — its goal is: Know the home row and where your fingers go.

quiz.q: Which of these did today's lesson focus on?
options: typing the bottom row: Z X C V B N M
typing punctuation: . , ? !
typing smoothly with both hands
the home row: A S D F and J K L ;
quiz.explain: Today's focus was the home row: A S D F and J K L ;.
